messages:
maria: quick check — i'm running `terraform apply` in prod and it stalled during an import of a k8s secret (sops-encrypted). plan showed 0 changes but apply hung on 'Refreshing state...' then timed out acquiring lock. anyone seeing this pattern?

jonathan: are you on the prod workspace and using the remote backend? can you paste the tail of the terraform output (or the lock id if present)?

maria: yes remote backend (s3/dynamo). tail: ```
Refreshing Terraform state in the background...\n
Acquiring state lock. This may take a few moments...\n
Error: Error acquiring the state lock: Error locking state: ConditionalCheckFailedException: The conditional request failed\n
Lock Info:\n  ID: 8a1f4c2e-9b2a-4f1b-b5d2-3c9e7d6a1b2c\n  Who: maria@redwood\n  Version: 1\n  Created: 2026-03-17T14:05:12Z\n  Info: terraform import k8s_secret.prod/sops-secret
```

infra-bot: background: deploy pipeline reports no concurrent terraform apply in the last 10m. There is a lease in backend table (lock id above).

lee: two quick checks: 1) is there an operator (secrets reconciler) actively mutating the secret while you're importing? 2) can you run `terraform state pull` to inspect the lock entry locally (don't modify it)?

maria: operator is running (sealed-secrets + sops-controller). i pulled state: shows lock with the ID above and same who. i think the import got interrupted mid-step when the operator recreated the secret, so terraform left a lock.

jonathan: if you're sure no other apply is live, run `terraform force-unlock 8a1f4c2e-9b2a-4f1b-b5d2-3c9e7d6a1b2c` from the same workspace. WARNING: only if you're certain.

lee: also check `kubectl get secret sops-secret -n prod -o yaml` — if operator rewrote the secret, TF import may try to replace it on apply and get into a race. We usually add `lifecycle.ignore_changes = [data]` for operator-managed secrets.

maria: ran `force-unlock` and re-ran `terraform apply` after pausing the sops-controller reconcile (annotated the secret with `operator.redwood.io/paused=true`). apply completed: 0 to change, 0 to add, 0 to destroy. the operator replayed but didn't clobber the import.

sara: nice. can we add a short pre-check to CI that fails if there is a backend lock older than 2m before starting an apply? avoids manual inspection next time.

jonathan: agree. also add docs for secrets: operator-managed secrets should be imported with `ignore_changes` or we should shift to creating them via operator only. created issue: #678 (infra: secret import race with operator).

maria: tl;dr: import stalled leaving a dynamo lock; forced unlock + paused operator + reapply fixed it. i'll open a small PR to add ignore_changes for that module and the CI pre-check. thanks all :thumbsup:
